name: Knowledge
description: Build a shared knowledge graph from tracker items
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.tagline: A shared vocabulary for team knowledge graphs
marketplace.longDescription: Knowledge teaches the agent how to set up and write a knowledge graph in your project: entities, claims, questions, findings, and investigations as tracker types, with a small set of verbs for statements. Graphs built this way stay consistent across projects and show up in the team wiki.
highlights: Standard tracker types for entities, claims, questions, findings, and investigations
A predicate registry for typed statements between entities
Guidance for writing claims with a stated basis and conditions

claudePlugin.description: Set up and write a team knowledge graph with tracker types
